scoring_justification: Cannot recompute full TM/MC simulations inside the checker; therefore compare reported phase boundary points, heat of adsorption values, and isobar coverage to paper-reported numeric reference (tricritical point coordinates, heat step magnitude, isobar plateau temperature) with tolerances, plus structural trends.

columns.coverage: monolayer coverage, float (optional for μ-ω3 points)

outputs.description: Phase boundary points for the μ-ω3 and coverage-temperature phase diagrams of the lattice-gas model with NN/2NN exclusion and finite 3NN repulsion. Each row corresponds to a point on a phase boundary, labelled by the nature of the transition and the method used.

columns.coverage: CO coverage in monolayers, float between 0 and 1
columns.Est_eV: isosteric heat of adsorption in eV, float

outputs.description: Coverage-dependent isosteric heat of adsorption computed for ω2=0.17 eV, ω3=0.03 eV at T=300 K using transfer matrix in the grand canonical ensemble.

columns.pressure_Torr: CO gas pressure in Torr, float

outputs.description: Adsorption isobars (coverage vs temperature at fixed pressures) for the final set of interaction parameters, using the relation between pressure and chemical potential with ε_b=1.60 eV and ν₀=10¹³ s⁻¹.

output_contract.notes: The phase_boundaries.csv file may contain points from both the μ-ω3 and coverage-T diagrams; rows corresponding to the μ-ω3 diagram will have a coverage column left blank or set to NaN. The heat_adsorption.csv covers the full coverage range up to 1 ML. The adsorption_isobars.csv should include at least the p_CO = 1×10⁻⁷ Torr curve and may include additional pressures.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for phase tricritical point coordinates, heat step thresholds, isobar plateau temperature
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: tricritical point 'near (βμ,βω3)=(5.1,0.2)' (Sec. III/Appendix); heat of adsorption sharp drop after 0.5 ML with Est ≈ ε_b - 4ω2 ≈ 0.92 eV; isobar inflection around 420 K for 1e-7 Torr (Sec. VI).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from paper values; heat estimate derived from model formula Est(θ>0.5) ~ ε_b - 4ω2 with ε_b=1.60 eV, ω2=0.17 eV, giving ~0.92 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: all reference numbers are explicitly stated or directly derivable from the paper's model and reported in the paper; no synthetic creation.
